query: Currently when future tasks are scheduled via EventExecutors from a different thread, at least two allocations are performed - the ScheduledFutureTask wrapping the to-be-run task, and a Runnable wrapping the action to add to the scheduled task priority queue. The latter can be avoided by incorporating this logic into the former. AbstractScheduledEventExecutor PromiseTask ScheduledFutureTask
